scientific.integrity: The paper-form ACProp first moment is solved exactly under an alternating input, the centered residual is explicit, and the delayed second-moment limit follows from a stable EMA of a geometrically convergent forcing sequence. A matched asynchronous uncentered control is solved exactly for comparison.
limitations: Paper-form unrectified ACProp without weight decay or AMSGrad-style options.
Theorem concerns update amplitude rather than convergence on a fixed objective.
Bias correction and implementation options are outside the exact transient statement.

title: ACProp has a sharp Nyquist centering gain
